theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hfin : (Set.range f).Finite :=
    Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T))
      (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr fun n => by simp [f, Set.mem_Icc, Prod.le_def, hB])
  have hpq : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! h
    refine Set.not_infinite.mpr hfin (Set.infinite_range_of_injective fun a b e => ?_)
    rcases lt_trichotomy a b with lt | rfl | lt
    · exact absurd e (h a b lt)
    · rfl
    · exact absurd e.symm (h b a lt)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ := hpq
  have hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, (u (n + 4) : ℝ) =
      (u (n + 3) + u (n + 2) + u (n + 1) * u n : ℝ) / (u (n + 3) * u (n + 2) + u (n + 1) + u n) :=
    fun n => (hu (n + 4) (by omega)).1
  have hf : ∀ m : ℕ, f (i + m) = f (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact heq
    | succ m ih =>
      simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at ih ⊢
      have h4 : u (i + m + 4) = u (j + m + 4) := by
        refine Int.cast_inj (α := ℝ) |>.mp ?_
        rw [hrec (j + m), ← ih.1, ← ih.2.1, ← ih.2.2.1, ← ih.2.2.2, ← hrec (i + m)]
      exact ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, h4⟩
  refine ⟨i, j - i, by omega, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have H := congrArg Prod.fst (hf (n - i))
  rw [show i + (n - i) = n from by omega, show j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) from by omega] at H
  exact H.symm
